Source: EC225 LP Flight Manual. VTOSS 35–60 kt: RFM Section CAT.A.A1, Figures 1b–6b (MAKILA 2A1), rev 11-51 (digitized from the RFM PDF and human-verified 2026-07-25, including dashed-line uncapped extensions and the −1,000 ft row). VTOSS 65–80 kt: RFM Section 2.2.A1, Figure 1b (MAKILA 2A1), rev 11-50 (plot-identical to CAT.A.A1 Figure 7b). All: Cat A / Clear Area / MPAI Bullets Closed / No P3 Air Bleed. Bilinear interpolation on uncapped chart values; final result capped at MTOW 11,000 kg. SUP 11.1 / SUP 28 corrections applied to the uncapped value before the cap. A small cold-weather/low-altitude corner of some charts is unreadable past the chart edge and is held at the nearest known value — always at or above 11,300 kg uncapped, so the displayed result there is MTOW.
